title: The visualisation audit
description: The Spec Auditor pattern, pointed at the rendered page. The auditor is given the finished HTML and the aggregate JSON it was built from, and checks one against the other. It is deliberately NOT given the renderer's own account of what it drew — a page audited against the code that produced it agrees with itself by construction, which is the same circularity that let the tuning crew's parachute rule pass every audit it ever faced.

verdict.description: pass if every check passed; fail if any number, label or attribution on the page disagrees with the data; error if the page could not be read.

claim.description: The thing on the page you checked, quoted or located precisely.

evidence.description: The comparison, with both numbers in it. Required on a pass as well as a fail — a pass with no evidence is indistinguishable from a check that was never performed.

usability.description: Judgement calls about whether the page communicates, reported and never enforced. These can never fail the audit.
